path.description: Where the credential is in the submitted presentation. Without `path_nested`, this must be `$.verifiableCredential[<n>]`, where `<n>` is an index from 0 to 999 with no leading zeros. With `path_nested`, this must be `$` or `$[0]`. Any other value is rejected with 400 `presentation_jsonpath_unsupported`. An index with no credential is rejected with 400 `presentation_jsonpath_empty`.

path_nested.description: Optional. Used when `path` is `$` or `$[0]`, which select the submitted presentation. Its `path` must be `$.verifiableCredential[<n>]`, and it must not contain another `path_nested`.
